“What is real?” The ﬁrst theme predominates in Blade Runner, 
adapted from the novel Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? 
How does one distinguish an android (a synthetic human, 
called a replicant in the ﬁlm) from a human, especially when 
one might be an android oneself without knowing it? The sec-
ond theme is addressed in the short story “We Can Remember 
It for You Wholesale,” upon which Total Recall is loosely based. 
Here Dick’s concern is with the implantation of false memories.
